title: Credit
description: Information about credits performed on an order.

active.description: If active is false, credit is considered uneditable. The only way to change this property is through an internal Admin endpoint or the mergePatch endpoint. Editable: true

creditTransactions.description: List of individual transactions to credit.

currency.description: The currency used for this credit.

customerNumber.description: ID of the customer who owns this credit.

orderId.description: ID of the order this payment belongs to.

orderVersion.description: Version of the order this credit belongs to.

organisationId.description: ID of the organisation who created this credit.

settlementId.description: Supplied to the client by an external system for handling settlements. For Internal Entur Clients this is Entur’s Electronic Journal.

totalCreditAmount.description: Total amount to credit, represented in the standard currency. Maximum (totalDigits: 18, fractionDigits: 5) according to ISO 20022. The integer and fractional digits are separated by a dot.

CreditTransactionResponse.title: CreditTransaction

amount.description: Amount to credit, represented in the standard currency. Maximum (totalDigits: 18, fractionDigits: 5) according to ISO 20022. The integer and fractional digits are separated by a dot.

createdAt.description: Timestamp for when transaction was first created.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code. Default is NOK.

newGiftCardId.description: Reference to the gift card id (contract uuid) the credited payment transaction belongs to. Note: This field will be set if the transaction was credited to a gift card.

paymentId.description: Reference to the payment the credited payment transaction belongs to.

paymentTransactionId.description: Reference to the transaction this credit transaction credits.

rrn.description: Reconciliation reference number used to track a transaction through different economy systems.

transactionData.description: Extra transaction data from external client. Only relevant for clients using the import flow.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp for when transaction was last updated.

CreditTransactionResponse.description: Represents a credit transaction referring to a payment transaction.
